policies.title: Turkish ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: Türkiye's current MFA table confirms that ordinary Turkish passport holders require a visa for Equatorial Guinea; the destination service supplies the electronic route.
Use the same regular Turkish passport for application and travel. The service states the eVisa is emailed and downloadable as a PDF before travel.
Work, residence, diplomatic, service, special-document, carrier and final-admission treatment are outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa application (VFS)
steps: Apply online using the ordinary Turkish passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa for final immigration processing and admission.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's ordinary-passport table requires a visa and Equatorial Guinea's current Government-authenticated service supplies electronic issuance before travel.
